images.subject: A metal storage depot built around one row of giant armored silos standing side by side against the cliff. On the right side of the frame, on the ground beside the silos, a second large and clearly separate block: a wide open-air storage yard covered with huge stacks of silver metal ingots, spanned by one giant gantry crane.
images.detail: Wide open bays at the base of each silo reveal stacks of huge silver metal ingots.
